# Syrax Solutions

> Syrax Solutions is a Sydney-based Australian company that provides automated drone herd monitoring for grazing properties. A drone-in-a-box (DJI Dock 3) lives on the property, flies a mapped route each day, and Syrax software turns the flight into a cattle head count by paddock, plus water trough, feed bunk, fence line and welfare checks. Results are sent by SMS, daily summary, weekly email and a phone and web app.

Key facts:
- Service area: Australia-wide. Based in Sydney, NSW.
- What it counts: cattle, by paddock, compared with the previous flight. Each report includes the aerial photo with every animal marked.
- Flight timing: counting flights run mid-morning, when shadows are short, so cattle under trees are easier to see.
- Hardware: a weatherproof dock and an enterprise drone with visual and thermal cameras. Syrax assesses the property, installs the dock and maps routes.
- Property needs: power at the dock site and a mobile or satellite internet connection.
- Welfare flags are prompts to check an animal, not a veterinary diagnosis.
- Individual animal identification is not currently offered.
- Pricing: a fixed quote after a property assessment.

## Product
- [Drone cattle counting, every day, by paddock](https://anajuliabriito.github.io/syrax-website/cattle-counting/): Automated drone cattle counting for Australian grazing properties. A docked drone counts every head by paddock each day and texts you what changed.
- [Water and feed, checked from the air every day](https://anajuliabriito.github.io/syrax-website/water-and-feed-monitoring/): Check every water trough and feed bunk from the air each day. Syrax flags low troughs and empty bunks before your cattle go without.
- [Fence breaks and animals that need a look, found the same day](https://anajuliabriito.github.io/syrax-website/fence-and-welfare-checks/): Find fence breaks, open gates and animals that need attention the same day. Daily drone checks for Australian cattle properties.
- [How Syrax works](https://anajuliabriito.github.io/syrax-website/how-it-works/): A weatherproof dock on your property, a drone on a daily schedule and software that tells you what changed. See how Syrax works.

## FAQ
- What does setup involve? A property assessment, installing the dock and mapping your routes. We handle all of it.
- What does my property need? Power at the dock site and a mobile or satellite connection. We check both in the assessment.
- Can I use a drone I already own? Syrax is built around the DJI Dock 3. If you already have DJI enterprise equipment, we'll check whether it can be used.
- Does anyone need to fly the drone? No. The dock launches, lands and charges it on schedule.
- Do I need a drone licence? No. We handle the operating requirements as part of setup.
- Will the drone stress my cattle? It flies well above the herd on the same route every day. Cattle get used to it quickly.
- What happens in bad weather? The dock waits out unsafe conditions and flies when it's safe.
- Why do flights run mid-morning? Short shadows. Cattle under trees are easiest to see, so counts are most reliable.
- How do I know a count is right? Every report shows the photo with every animal marked, and compares it with the previous flight.
- Does it identify individual animals? Not yet. Syrax counts head by paddock and flags changes.
- Who can see my data? Only the people you give access to. Every account uses secure sign-in.
- What does it cost? It depends on your property. You get a fixed quote after the assessment.
